exposure: delivery timing (beyond 36 0/7 weeks vs prior to 36 0/7 weeks gestational age)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 202 pregnancies at >=24 0/7 weeks of gestation complicated by prenatally suspected placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: For patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum without other indications for delivery, a planned delivery in the late preterm or early term period does not negatively affect maternal outcomes but improves neonatal outcomes.
